Screen reader test: Superstore_Product_West

Expected text (open after listening, to compare)

Alt text (128 characters): Superstore Product Drilldown, West region: monthly sales heatmap by category 2022-2025 and sales vs. profit dot plot by product.

Summary: Product Drilldown dashboard from the Superstore workbook, filtered to the West region. Top chart, Sales by Product Category: a heatmap of monthly sales for Furniture, Office Supplies and Technology from 2022 to 2025, with darker blue meaning higher sales; monthly values range from $144 to $20,352. The highest month is Technology in March 2025 at $20,352, followed by Office Supplies in October 2025 ($16,222) and August 2025 ($14,860), Furniture in December 2024 ($14,417) and Technology in July 2025 ($13,871). Sales are generally strongest from September to December, especially for Furniture, whose highest month was December in 2022, 2023 and 2024. The lowest month is Furniture in February 2022 at $144, and Technology has no sales in January 2022. Bottom chart, Sales and Profit by Product Names: a dot plot where each dot is a product, placed by sales, in rows for each sub-category and columns for the Consumer, Corporate and Home Office segments. Dot color shows profit ratio, from red (-50%, losing money) to dark grey (+50%). Most products sell under $5,000. Red, loss-making products cluster in Bookcases, Tables, Supplies and Machines. The largest outliers are a Copiers product in Consumer near $14,000 and a Binders product in Corporate near $7,000.
